units.source_text: 父亲以及在场的哥哥，一起走了进来。

en.t: Father and my elder brother, who was there, came in together.

units.source_text: 也许是被母亲可怕的脸惊吓到了吧！

en.t: Perhaps they had been frightened by Mother's terrible expression.

units.source_text: 平时一向低调谨慎的父亲也一脸茫然，不知所措。

en.t: Even Father, who was usually quiet and cautious, looked blank and did not know what to do.

units.source_text: 母亲却勉强的挤出微笑，说：“哎呦，不是什么大不了的事儿。

en.t: Mother, however, forced out a smile and said, "Oh, it is nothing serious.

units.source_text: 只是不小心被指甲划破了罢了。

en.t: I only scratched myself by accident with a fingernail.
I still have to hurry and make lunch."
